text_block_list.text:
"A peaceful lunch break with white clouds 
drifting across the blue sky—at last."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Starting today, this academy has been 
hijacked by the phantom villain Windy~!"

"The Great Plan for Windy-chan to Hijack 
the Academy" has begun!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I've blocked all your exits! If you want 
to get out, there is only one way!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Solve the mystery and find Windy-chan! 
Wahahaha!"

Things developed so suddenly... I was a 
bit worried whether everything would go 
smoothly, but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! A mystery-solving event! I love 
those!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Taiki-san, Taiki-san! There are lots 
of black letters in the hallway! Let's 
open them!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Eek! A spider!? —Wait, it's just a toy! 
Jeez!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
That hallway over there was blocked off 
with boards! That's amazing, when did they 
even set that up?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you over there! I don't mind you 
having fun, but don't get hurt!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I prepared myself for some 
confusion when I looked over the proposal, 
but the response has exceeded my 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, everyone is beaming with joy... 
Wonderful. Her planning skills are truly 
exceptional.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Despite how it seems. Notifying us in 
advance was likely groundwork to prevent 
anyone from throwing cold water on it—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Above all, their risk management is 
magnificent. It truly shows how frequently 
they make their moves.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I hope it turns out to be a 
wonderful event.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. ...Although, she herself probably 
just thinks of it as "playing a prank."

Under the watchful eyes of the student 
council, 'Windy-chan's Grand Academy 
Takeover Plan' progressed steadily.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Shi-shi-shi! Well? Was everyone surprised?

To be honest, rather than being surprised, 
most of the Umamusume seemed to simply be 
enjoying themselves, but—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Kufufufufu! Right, right?! It's only 
na~tural!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heheh, think you can catch Windy-chan?

Yes, after hiding under the stairs 
nervously for dozens of minutes— I heard 
the sound of footsteps running from afar!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hm!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Found you! Phantom Windy has been spotted!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Figuring out the riddle was tough, but...! 
Once I've found you, it's my win! Prepare 
yourself—!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, fufufufu!! Ah-hah-hah-hah-hah!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm the evil monster, Windy-chan! You 
guys'll never catch meeee!

And as we ran away, the students giving 
chase grew more and more numerous—

text_block_list.name: Crowd of Students
text_block_list.text: Wait, Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wah-hah-hah-hah! Catch me if you can~~!

I watched as Shinko Windy scampered off 
with a beaming smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Where is it~?! Based on the answer, it 
should be around here, but...

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Come out, Windy! You've set up way too 
many jack-in-the-boxes!

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text: Hey, let's go check out over there too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehe, take that, classmates! Heheheh!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: They're all looking for Windy-chan, see~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nfufu, hey Trainer! Next we're moving over 
there!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll just show myself for a second and 
cause a huge ruckus! Hehehe!

Her initial goal—to scare them— didn't 
seem to work, but... Shinko Windy seemed 
completely delighted anyway.
